title: The Exact Time-Uniform Rate Frontier for Stochastic Gradient Descent on Smooth Convex Objectives
abstract: arXiv:2609.08537v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: We study the time-uniform convergence of the raw iterate of standard stochastic gradient descent (SGD) for unconstrained smooth convex objectives. We prove that, under standard noise assumptions, the time-uniform convergence rate gets arbitrarily close to $\sqrt{\log n / n}$ but never reaches it. More specifically, we prove that for every positive, eventually nondecreasing sequence $h$ satisfying $h(n) = o(\sqrt{n})$, a bound of order $h(n)/\sqrt{n}$, holding simultaneously for all $n$ with probability at least $1-\alpha$ and uniformly over the problem class, is achievable if and only if \[   \sum_{j = 1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{h(2^j)^2} < \infty. \] The constructive sufficiency result follows from a dyadic horizon-free schedule together with an additive conditional-restart inequality. The necessity counterpart applies to every deterministic nonnegative schedule and holds even for a one-dimensional analytic smooth convex objective with Gaus

translated_title: 光滑凸目标函数上随机梯度下降的精确时间一致收敛率前沿
translated_abstract: 我们研究了标准随机梯度下降（SGD）的原始迭代在无约束光滑凸目标函数上的时间一致收敛性。我们证明，在标准噪声假设下，时间一致收敛率可以任意接近 $\sqrt{\log n / n}$，但永远无法达到该值。更具体地说，我们证明，对于每个满足 $h(n) = o(\sqrt{n})$ 的正的、最终非递减的序列 $h$，一个阶为 $h(n)/\sqrt{n}$ 的界——要求对所有 $n$ 同时以至少 $1-\alpha$ 的概率成立并在整个问题类上一致成立——是可实现的，当且仅当 $\sum_{j=1}^{\infty} \frac{1}{h(2^j)^2} < \infty$。构造性的充分性证明来自一种无视野的二分（dyadic）步长调度，并结合了一个可加条件重启不等式。必要性结果则适用于所有确定性的非负调度，即使对于一维解析光滑凸目标且带高斯（噪声）的情形依然成立。
tldr: 该论文精确刻画了标准SGD在光滑凸目标上时间一致收敛率的可实现边界——阶为 $h(n)/\sqrt{n}$ 的界可实现当且仅当 $\sum 1/h(2^j)^2 < \infty$，且收敛率可任意接近但永远达不到 $\sqrt{\log n / n}$。
en_tdlr: This paper precisely characterizes the time-uniform rate frontier for standard SGD on smooth convex objectives: a bound of order $h(n)/\sqrt{n}$ is achievable if and only if $\sum 1/h(2^j)^2 < \infty$, with rates arbitrarily close to but never reaching $\sqrt{\log n / n}$.
